title: Reader restart restores the chapter but loses the exact intra-chapter position
symptom: After reopening the app, the reader often returned to the correct chapter but drifted back toward the top instead of the exact saved reading position.
root_cause: Progress bootstrap and UI restore were racing. A default or early anchor could be written back before the chapter content and scroll state had fully restored, which let a zero or near-zero position overwrite a previously saved non-zero anchor.
fix: Deferred position restore until the target chapter content had finished loading.
Blocked initial progress bootstrap when a valid non-zero saved anchor already existed.
Added regression coverage for long-chapter restore so restart recovery is verified automatically.
impact: Resume-reading continuity broke on long books. Users could reopen the same chapter but still lose the exact place they stopped at, which is a high-friction failure for a reading app.
